notes.title: 1.5.0 Version Update
notes.content:
1.5.0 Version Features:
[olist]
    Main menu and in-game UI updated.

    Some program architecture updated.

    Mouse click sound effect updated.

    New gravity acceleration added.

    Partial integration of game assets.

    All difficulty levels are unlocked from the beginning.

    All NPC's items are unlocked in the free version.

    Experience curve slightly lowered.
[/olist]

1.5.1 Version Features:
[olist]
    Reduce reset potion price to 1000.
[/olist]

notes.title: 1.4.0 Version Update
notes.content:
1.4.0 Version Features:
[olist]
    Dividing the game into three levels - easy, medium, and difficult - each of which can be saved independently.

    In the settings, players can now adjust their own mouse sensitivity.

    The update reduces the stamina cost of heavy attacks by 10%.

    The game's window mode now has three different sizes, and players can move their mouse outside of the window.

    Version 1.4.0 utilizes DirectX 11, resulting in more realistic grass.

    Running is now possible by pressing the left or right shift keys.

    The game now displays the percentage of vitality and stamina during battles.
[/olist]

1.4.1 Version Features:
[olist]
    The 1.4.1 version update contains some minor UI changes.
[/olist]

notes.title: 1.3.0 Version Update
notes.content:
1.3.0 Version Features:
[olist]
    We have added many NPCs to the free version, including a merchant, and removed a dragon from the full version.

    The premium version now includes a reset potion in the elf's bags, which allows you to reset all your talent points without having to restart the game.

    Merchants now carry more items in their bags.

    We have resolved a bug that caused items in the merchant's bag to disappear.
[/olist]

1.3.1 Version Features:
[olist]
    The conversations have been extended to provide more content and depth.

    The game now includes seven items each of helmets, breastplates, belts, and boots, all of which share similar styles.

    The number of weapons available in the game has been increased.

    A compass function has been added to the mini-map.
[/olist]

1.3.2 Version Features:
[olist]
    The fighting system has been updated to include heavy and light attacks, enhancing the overall enjoyment of battles.

    The game has undergone some minor adjustments, including changes to art and character values for NPCs.

    The help page has been updated.
[/olist]

1.3.3 Version Features:
[olist]
    Button click sounds have been increased for a better user experience.

    Various bugs have been fixed.
[/olist]

1.3.4 Version Features:
[olist]
    Santa Claus now has the ability to rename your character and change its gender without deleting saved data.
[/olist]

1.3.5 Version Features:
[olist]
    The quality of certain dialogues has been slightly improved.

    There have been some small updates to the GUI.

    Two towers have been added into the game.

    The color of sunlight has been updated.
[/olist]

1.3.6 Version Features:
[olist]
    Version 1.3.6 now delivers 50% better FPS performance compared to version 1.3.5 under the same hardware.

    A time display error has been resolved.

    The HP-bar label has been divided into vitality and food.

    A map explanation has been added.

    Mouse sensitivity and acceleration have been reduced.

    High-quality terrain textures have replaced the basic ones.
[/olist]

notes.title: 1.2.0 Version Update
notes.content:
1.2.0 Version Features:
[olist]
    We are currently working on reducing the game's hardware requirements. The performance requirements of the game have been reduced by 10% in this update.
[/olist]

1.2.1 Version Features:
[olist]
    We have adjusted the camera sensitivity and added 3D grass on the ground.
[/olist]

1.2.2 Version Update Features:
[olist]
    We have added four new dragon NPCs and three new products to the King's bag, which will allow players to level up more smoothly. Note that the free version only includes two dragon NPCs and three new products.

    We have also made adjustments to the talent point system:
For each point in strength: 100 vitality 50 stamina → 120 vitality 50 stamina
For each point in agility: 5 attack 2.5 defense → 5 attack 2 defense
[/olist]
